title: The Deep
summary: The four underground layers of the Overworld, with their blocks, ores, monsters, levels and drops, plus Abandoned Mine Camps and Runeforged armour.

s.x: The deeper you dig, the stranger the caves get. Underground, the Overworld is split into four
, each with its own look, monsters, level bonus and drops. Going down is how you find the best ores, and the layers are where the Mining skill, Delving and Combat meet.
, within its height band, and out of sight of the sky. Heights run from the lowest block of the band, so Glimmer Caverns covers y 0 to 39.

Cave surfaces (stone, deepslate, tuff, granite, diorite, andesite, dirt and gravel next to cave air) are restyled as chunks generate, about 60 to 75% of them depending on the layer. Edges between layers blur by about 3 blocks, so layers bleed together. Nothing within 3 blocks of the surface changes, water-filled caves stay as they were, and vanilla lush caves, dripstone caves and the deep dark are left alone. Chunks made before the update keep their old look, but the monsters, levels and drops still apply.
A layer's bonus stacks with the usual underground levels (+5 below y 0, +10 below y -32). In the Magma Rifts that is +10 and +14, so
+24 on top of the surface level for that distance

Every 3 seconds, near each survival player in a layer, a group spawns 10 to 24 blocks away on solid ground in the dark (block light of at most 7 to 9, depending on the layer), up to 6 to 8 layer monsters within 40 blocks. They can despawn normally.
Entering a layer shows its name, skulls and level bonus. You are only counted as in a new layer once you are 2 blocks past the edge, and the same layer's title is not repeated for a minute.
Monsters killed by a player inside roll the layer's drop: Glimmer Geode 3%, Glowcap Spores 30% (1 to 2), Dwarven Cog 25%, Rift Ember 25% (1 to 2).
